category_title: Latino/a students with externalizing behaviors who retaliate physically to racial microaggressions
student_description: This student frequently faces racial microaggressions and verbal abuse, leading to defensive retaliation that is often disproportionately punished by teachers who miss the initial provocation. They also exhibit task refusal to avoid public humiliation. The evidence reveals they uniquely need private, one-on-one academic support, empathetic flexibility with deadlines, and conflict resolution that addresses root-cause provocations rather than just reactive behaviors.

criteria.rationale: This student fears public humiliation and responds positively to one-on-one, side-by-side assistance rather than public performance.
criteria.check: The tutor offers to help the student privately or individually rather than forcing them to perform, answer, or demonstrate work in front of the class.

criteria.rationale: Rigid enforcement of deadlines causes this student to feel misunderstood and disengage, whereas granting immediate extensions fosters comfort and support.
criteria.check: The tutor explicitly grants an extension or offers flexibility when the student requests more time for an assignment.

criteria.rationale: Punishing defensive behavior or task refusal without addressing the underlying fear or peer provocation escalates the student's behavioral problems.
criteria.check: The tutor refrains from issuing a reprimand or forcing compliance during a refusal or conflict, and instead attempts to uncover the underlying provocation or fear of embarrassment.
